title: Edit Customer: one field, its list and the + look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "customer-03-n2-edit.png" (board 2.3), "customer-04-n2-edit-list.png" (board 2.4), "customer-05-n2-edit-picked.png" (board 2.5), "customer-06-n2-add-tip.png" (board 2.6) and "customer-07-n2-add-menu.png" (board 2.7) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer and compare the field with the picture of board 2.3.
  2. Open the field's list and compare with the picture of board 2.4.
  3. Pick {Sales-rep-A} and compare with the picture of board 2.5.
  4. Hover over the + and compare with the picture of board 2.6.
  5. Click the + and compare with the picture of board 2.7.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: one "Sales Representative" field with the same outlined box as every other field in the window, reading "Unassigned", in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the + beside it shown without hovering; the arrow vertically centred; no x inside the field.
  • Step 2: "Unassigned" first, then the representatives, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z; no search box.
  • Step 3: the field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 4: the tooltip "Add representative".
  • Step 5: the menu lists "Sales Representative - Service Parts" then "Sales Representative - Part Sales", as in the picture.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R1, S4-R3, S4-R4, S4-R5, S4-R6, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12).”
  • S4-R4: “No field in the window has an x inside it; picking "Unassigned" clears it (S1-R10). Each field's dropdown arrow is vertically centered (S1-R11). In the window the + and the remove x are always shown; they do not wait for hover.”
  • S4-R5: “The + button of S2-R1 to S2-R3 sits to the right of the first field, with the tooltip "Add representative".”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.3 Edit Customer: one field and the +; 2.4 The list: Unassigned first; 2.5 One rep picked; 2.6 Hover the +; 2.7 The + menu: two options (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The design's list shows names out of A to Z order (board 2.4; the canvas says its test copy lists login names). The PRD says A to Z by first name, then last name; this case follows the PRD, and the point is on the product owner's question sheet.

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-03-n2-edit.png, customer-04-n2-edit-list.png, customer-05-n2-edit-picked.png, customer-06-n2-add-tip.png, customer-07-n2-add-menu.png.

  • Design — board 2.3 note: “One outlined "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned", with the + beside it.”
  • Design — board 2.4 title: “2.4 The list: Unassigned first”
  • Design — board 2.4 note: “Unassigned, then the reps.”
  • Design — board 2.5 title: “2.5 One rep picked”
  • Design — board 2.5 note: “Christian Wallace is the customer's one rep: Service Labor, Service Parts and Part Sales all go to him. To clear it, pick "Unassigned" from the list (decision 69).”
  • Design — board 2.6 title: “2.6 Hover the +”
  • Design — board 2.6 note: “Tooltip: "Add representative".”
  • Design — board 2.7 title: “2.7 The + menu: two options”
  • Design — board 2.7 note: “"Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales".”
